messages:
ella: Brainstorm: two webinar angles — (A) 'Serving predictably at scale' focused on ops tradeoffs and runbooks, (B) 'Cut inference cost without losing quality' focused on batching/quant and benchmarks. Which resonates more for our Q4 pipeline?
marta: Both are good. lean B for revenue motion (cost benchmarks speak to CFO/engineering buyers) but include a short ops > 1-slide appendix so platform teams see it.
jim: agree with marta. pick B as headline, but we need an ops-friendly subtitle: "how to hit latency SLOs while cutting per-token cost".
rana: Speakers: propose alex for demo, leo for customer vignette, marta for benchmark narrative, jim host. Ella can own landing copy + inbound routing.
ella: noted. Draft abstracts — quick pass below, pls edit: 
- Abstract v1 (headline): "Cut inference cost without losing quality: real-world benchmarks & practical knobs". short blurb: "We show concrete config changes (batching, cache, quantization) and the real $$ impact on throughput & latency using open models on Redwood."
- Abstract v2 (ops subtitle): "Operational playbook to keep demos reliable" (appendix slide).
marta: Edit suggestion: add a line about model fallbacks and predictable SLAs. Example: "plus tactics for graceful degradation & fallback routing to keep customer-facing apps online."
jim: Rehearsal plan: I want 3 rehearsals: tech check (15m), run-through (30m), dress (45m). We should do tech check 48h before, run-through 24h before, dress 2h before.
rana: Agree. Also propose a 10-min 'speaker sync' an hour before show to surface any last-minute slide swaps.
devops-bot: Calendar event created: Webinar - Cost & Benchmarks (2024-10-09 17:00 UTC). Invitees: [ella,marta,jim,alex,leo,rana]. Green room link in event.
ella: Landing page copy: short form + 3 bullets (what you'll learn). Draft below, please quick edit: 
"Join us to see how engineering teams drop per-inference costs with a few production-ready knobs. We'll share benchmarks, demo a resilient serving flow, and leave you with a checklist to try in your stack."
marta: tighten: replace "a few production-ready knobs" with "concrete config levers". Add CTA: "Register to get the benchmark dataset & replay."
jim: Lead routing: funneling strategy: register -> lead score based on company size + usage intent -> immediately send 'benchmarks pack' email to high intent. Ella can wire leads to SFDC campaign: 'Webinar-Oct-CostBenchmarks'.
ella: I'll wire campaign. ask: what asset should be gated for high-intent? full benchmark CSV + quick-start scripts?
marta: CSV + reproducible scripts + a short how-to for quantization. good gating value.
ella: Run-of-show (first pass): 
00:00 - host welcome & agenda (jim, 2m)
02:00 - benchmark story + key graph (marta, 6m)
08:00 - configuration levers & tradeoffs (marta, 6m)
14:00 - live demo: warm cache + deterministic prompt (alex, 8m)
22:00 - customer vignette (leo, 5m)
27:00 - live Q&A (moderated, 10m)
37:00 - CTA + gated asset callout (jim, 3m)
40:00 - wrap

rana: For the demo: Alex please prepare a 90s backup clip and a simple toggled flow if live calls fail. Also please add a short script to warm cache and log tokens to spot cold-starts.
alex (via DM): Will do. I'll post the demo checklist and pre-record to the green room doc.
marta: Ops checklist for green room (short):
- confirm CDN link + fallback clip in slot
- verify presenters are co-hosts in Zoom
- mic levels + echo test
- share stage permissions for screenshare
- post-live routing: where to send on-demand replay (drive + youtube unlisted)

ella: Marketing asks: 1) copy for tweet thread + LinkedIn post, 2) 3 quick talking points for speakers, 3) 30s promo clip. I'll draft and share today.
jim: For speakers: two talking points each:
- marta: "benchmark takeaway" + "one cost knob to try"
- alex: "demo setup" + "fallback narrative"
- leo: "customer ROI" + "lessons learned"

rana: QA prep: Sophia (is she on?) can curate top 8 anticipated Qs. We'll pick 5 to read. Keep answers short.
ella: Final: after each rehearsal capture a 3-bullet postmortem in this thread: what worked, one fix, any slide edits. That will help finalize the landing page copy & follow-up email.
marta: Great. locking headline "Cut inference cost without losing quality" unless someone objects within 24h.
jim: No objections. locking. :white_check_mark: 
ella: I'll post the first promo draft by EOD. Thanks all.
